connectors.name: FortiNAC Device
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: FortiNAC appliance — SSH/CLI + REST API (72 tools). v0.12 adds 5 group writes: add/remove devices to/from a group, copy group, update GroupDto, delete group. For host/port/user groups use call_api with system/group/add-members (needs type byte).

connectors.name: FortiNAC Test Platform
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: FortiNAC TP browser connector — NFR read/edit + weekly status + comments, plus automation (labs, testcases, pytest runs, results) and get_lab_devices. v0.7.x uses the v2 /adc/automation/pytest/ API; list_testcases walks the new recursive tree shape and supports search/prefix filters.

connectors.name: Jenkins
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Jenkins REST API connector — trigger builds, monitor status, fetch console logs and artifacts. Server-side via API token. Folder-nested jobs supported. Multiple Jenkins instances in one install.

connectors.name: MantisBT
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + comment on MantisBT bugs from the user's logged-in browser session. Search, list attachments, download files, post notes.

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitLab REST API connector via Personal Access Token (encrypted at rest). 25+ tools for issues, MRs, projects, pipelines, branches, files, notes, todos.

connectors.name: Microsoft Teams
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + send messages in the Teams web client (v2 UI) via the user's logged-in session. Channels, group chats, 1:1 DMs.

connectors.name: PMDB
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read-only DOM extraction from PMDB (Product Management Database) using the user's logged-in browser session.

connectors.name: GitHub API
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitHub REST API connector — runs entirely server-side. Optional PAT for private repos / higher rate limits.

connectors.name: SCAP (Fortinet PSIRT)
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Fortinet PSIRT SCAP — reads the /reports/ffi table (Critical/High/Medium/Low counts per product build + report PDF URLs). v0.1: list_reports + find_for_product (browser DOM scrape, uses your logged-in Chrome session). Roadmap v0.2-0.4: PDF text extraction + auto-create Mantis bugs for blockers.
